meta.note: Auto-generated by taste analysis. Custom clusters are checked first by classify_quip().

clusters.description: Quips that commit to a specific, confident, and slightly provocative opinion or prediction — stated as if it were obvious, often as a challenge or declaration rather than an observation. Distinct from general_wit in that the quip takes a clear side rather than commenting from a distance. Distinct from sports in that it applies across categories.
evidence_quips: Toy Story 5 > The Odyssey
if Toy Story 5 doesn't clinch I'm going on hunger strike
name a bigger company that exists out of pure spite
if geopolitics was Catan, this is like blocking longest road with a port

clusters.description: Non-sports bets (tech, politics, crypto) described through a sports scenario/idiom, merging the separate 'expanded' variant into the single existing cluster
evidence_quips: like watching a 5' 2" middle-schooler sink a deep 3 at the buzzer
like a Sun Belt team winning an untelevised bowl game
like the Browns announcing a parade route in August

clusters.description: Quips that reference the bet's actual payout amount or market mechanics as the punchline
evidence_quips: Cancel this and you could give every American $44 which is exactly this payout. coincidence? i think not.
eggs now cost $73 dollars and are sold in packages of 3

clusters.description: Sports idioms/stakes applied as commentary on non-obviously-sports bets, distinct from direct named-athlete sports lines and from the narrow sports_analogy_crossover cluster
evidence_quips: it's anybody's ball game
the man needs 2 more and he has one game. Here we go!
when underdogs go back to being just dogs

clusters.description: Variations on the 'money printer go brrr' meme format applied to non-financial contexts (clemency, Fed chair, etc.) — can fold into internet_meme
evidence_quips: old man money printer
the clemency printer just got a new ink cartridge

clusters.description: Jokes that use a sports scenario/analogy to explain a non-sports bet outcome, distinct from pure sports bets
evidence_quips: like watching a 5' 2" middle-schooler sink a deep 3 at the buzzer
this is like if John Harbaugh tweeted a starting line up for OKC
like a Sun Belt team winning an untelevised bowl game
like the Browns announcing a parade route in August

clusters.description: Lines that escalate the bet premise into an increasingly absurd hypothetical chain of events
keywords: invade the moon to save face
evidence_quips: MyPillow pivoting to campaign finance
Trump, hot off Greenland fail, decides to invade the moon to save face
in other news: JD Vance tapped to be the next Pope

clusters.description: Editor quips that implicate 'I/me/my' directly as a personally affected bystander, distinct from person_has_opinion's third-party framing
evidence_quips: just please on the day I bring an umbrella
just please not on the day i wear layers
here's me suddenly caring about the democratic process
at this point I don't know how many deals we've had and I'm too embarrassed to ask
